These synthetic, credential-free fixtures were written by the installed Qt-backed
0.3.0 SDK before the full-module migration. They contain schema-1 Thinking Space
history and schema-3 author metadata with a Korean name, emoji, full-name detail,
roles and a document identifier. NativeMigration verifies exact history object
identities and complete JSON profile/ledger equivalence, then upgrades the file
without changing those object IDs. No Adobe source or real user document is included.
